new_categories.label: transfer_connection_interface_readiness
new_categories.memory: The delivered physical ship/shore cargo-transfer connection can be modeled as a service-state distinct from upstream pumps, valves and protective communication links.

new_categories.label: hose_or_loading_arm_readiness
new_categories.memory: The transfer-interface appliance can have its own readiness state without inferring exact type, rating, envelope or operating method.

new_categories.label: ship_manifold_side_readiness
new_categories.memory: Ship-side manifold/interface readiness is separable from the hose/loading-arm appliance and from the internal cargo-transfer path.

new_categories.label: shore_terminal_connection_side_readiness
new_categories.memory: The shore-side connection interface can be represented independently from the ship manifold and from terminal-wide readiness.

new_categories.label: support_alignment_confidence
new_categories.memory: A non-numeric support/alignment confidence state can be tracked without retaining geometry, movement envelope, connection method or adjustment procedure.

new_categories.label: containment_boundary_confidence
new_categories.memory: Connection-boundary containment confidence is distinct from simple mechanical connection readiness and from proof of any exact sealing arrangement.

new_categories.label: connection_vs_transfer_path_separation
new_categories.memory: A physically ready connection does not by itself establish the readiness of the broader transfer path, and the reverse is also true.

new_categories.label: monitoring_verification_confidence
new_categories.memory: Verification confidence can be represented separately from physical hardware condition without retaining test values, methods or acceptance criteria.

new_categories.label: connection_scope_localization
new_categories.memory: Degradation or restriction can be localized by hose/arm, manifold side, shore interface, containment boundary or transfer connection scope.

new_categories.label: alternate_connection_redundancy_confidence
new_categories.memory: Alternate connection/interface confidence can be represented abstractly without implying an approved substitution, changeover or operating sequence.

new_categories.label: transfer_connection_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: The connection service can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-verification and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: downstream_effect_not_root_cause_proof
new_categories.memory: Transfer restriction, terminal incompatibility, containment concern, rework or schedule impact should not by itself prove a hose, arm, manifold, alignment or boundary root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_connection_restoration
new_categories.memory: Physical readiness, containment confidence, verification completion and operational release may be restored at different times and should remain distinct.

useful_refinements.label: transfer_path_vs_physical_connection
useful_refinements.memory: P092-style transfer-path availability is refined by a separate physical ship/shore connection service-state rather than treated as identical.

useful_refinements.label: shutdown_link_vs_transfer_connection
useful_refinements.memory: P101-style protective shutdown-link readiness does not establish the physical hose/loading-arm/manifold connection or containment boundary.

useful_refinements.label: vapor_interface_vs_liquid_transfer_connection
useful_refinements.memory: A terminal-interface scope concept from vapor-control service helps boundary modeling but is not the same delivered liquid-cargo transfer connection.

useful_refinements.label: equipment_condition_vs_delivered_connection_service
useful_refinements.memory: Generic equipment condition refines component health but does not collapse connection, alignment, containment and verification into one state.

duplicates.label: generic_equipment_service_lifecycle
duplicates.memory: Generic equipment available/degraded/restricted/isolated/restored mechanics are already represented campaign-wide.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_isolation_and_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic scope-localization, downstream-effect separation and verified-restoration mechanics repeat prior service-state families.

reviewed_no_specific_memory: exact pressure, temperature, flange or connection details
exact connection/disconnection, alignment, release-device or testing sequences
named provider, terminal, incident or current-readiness facts
negative_space: exact vessel/terminal transfer-connection arrangements, hose/loading-arm/manifold types, ratings, pressures, temperatures, flange details, alignment envelopes, release devices, test values and current configuration
exact connection, disconnection, positioning, alignment, securing, release, testing, troubleshooting, transfer-coordination or emergency procedures
named hose/loading-arm/manifold providers, terminals, inspectors, incidents, deficiency findings and current readiness
private/regional transfer-interface equipment/service lineages plus non-English predecessor terminology
stop_reason: The bounded structural questions are answered; further recall trends toward exact equipment, rating, pressure, geometry, connection, testing, procedure, provider or incident detail that is deferred to Evidence.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive ship/shore transfer-connection service-state orientation/source-discovery output; not connection, disconnection, release, testing, cargo-transfer or emergency operating advice and not proof of any exact arrangement, rating, pressure, temperature, flange detail, procedure, provider, incident or current-readiness fact.
